title: /integrations/mullvad
description: Instructions on how to integrate Mullvad VPN api data into Home Assistant.
body:
The **Mullvad VPN**  uses the [Mullvad](https://mullvad.net/) VPN API to detect if your Home Assistant instance is connected to the Mullvad VPN service.

![](/static/help/images/screenshots__mullvad_vpn_sample_sensor_connected.png)
